questions.def: Past perfect is needed to show action before another past action.
questions.question: By the time he arrived, the concert ___ already begun.

questions.def: Third conditional requires 'had' to express a hypothetical past.
questions.question: If I ___ known, I would have acted differently.

questions.def: 'Has' should be 'had'. Past perfect continuous until a past event.
questions.question: She has been working here since she graduated.

questions.def: Past perfect shows completed action before another past action.
questions.question: He ___ in Paris before he moved to Rome.

questions.def: Present perfect continuous for an action started and continuing now.
questions.question: I ___ been studying all day, so I'm tired.

questions.def: 'Would have' expresses future in the past (reported speech).
questions.question: She said she ___ finished the report by then.

questions.def: In third conditional, 'would have' follows 'if + had'.
questions.question: If he would have studied, he would pass the exam easily.

questions.def: Past continuous for an action in progress at a specific time.
questions.question: They ___ for us when we arrived.

questions.def: Future perfect continuous for duration by a future time.
questions.question: By next year, I ___ been working here for five years.

questions.def: 'Wishes' followed by past perfect expresses regret about the past.
questions.question: He wishes he ___ listened to his advisor.

questions.def: 'Know' is a stative verb; use 'have known'.
questions.question: I am knowing her since we were children.

questions.def: Third conditional: 'if + had + past participle'.
questions.question: If she ___ harder, she would have passed.

questions.def: Third conditional for a hypothetical past situation and result.
questions.question: She ___ to the party if she had known about it.

questions.def: Future perfect continuous for duration leading to a future time.
questions.question: By the time I finish this, I ___ working for 10 hours.

questions.def: Past perfect indicates an action completed before another past action.
questions.question: I ___ him before, so I recognized him.

questions.def: Past perfect shows completed action before another past action.
questions.question: Before he retired, he ___ the company for 20 years.

questions.def: Past perfect with 'just' for recent completion before a past action.
questions.question: I ___ finished eating when you called.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous for duration before another past event.
questions.question: They ___ on the project for months before it was cancelled.

questions.def: Past perfect needed to show completion before a past action.
questions.question: He ___ already left when I arrived at the station.

questions.def: 'If only' implies regret using past perfect.
questions.question: If only I ___ studied harder for the exam.

questions.def: 'Since 2010' needs present perfect continuous: 'has been living'.
questions.question: She is living here since 2010.

questions.def: Past perfect continuous: action continuing until another past event.
questions.question: We ___ for hours before the train finally arrived.

questions.def: Future perfect continuous: continued action until a future time.
questions.question: By the time she graduates, she ___ been a student for 16 years.

questions.def: Regret about past action requires past perfect.
questions.question: He regretted that he ___ taken the job.

questions.def: 'Know' is a stative verb: use 'have known'.
questions.question: I am knowing him for a long time.

questions.def: Third conditional: if + had + past participle.
questions.question: If they ___ harder, they would have succeeded.

questions.def: Future in the past (reported speech): 'would have'.
questions.question: She said she ___ finished the project by the deadline.

questions.def: Past perfect: action finished before another past action.
questions.question: By the time we arrived, the movie ___ already started.

questions.def: Future Perfect indicates completion before another point in the future.
questions.question: By the time he arrives, I ___ the report.

questions.def: Third conditional: past unreal condition and result.
questions.question: If I had known, I ___ differently.
